source: Silen_Space_Gen_2_Meet_2.dwg (manufacturer CAD, millimetres). The 3D solids were read out of the file's data storage section with tools/cad, flat faces only.
axes: x to the right seen from the front, y from the back (0) to the front (-1107 to -1137), z up from the floor

footprint_mm.note: door handles reach to -1137; door swing arcs extend the drawing to -2072

front_frame_mm.height_note: outer frame from the bottom rail (z 10) to about 2230; the floating roof reaches z 2265. Height is read from the geometry by eye to about 20 mm.

glass_panes_mm.note: x ranges from the left edge; the door leaf is the middle pane

note: Features inside the pod (lights, table, sofas) sit 100 to 1000 mm behind the front plane, so a dot pinned to the front plane slides against them when the camera moves; see the README on 3D anchoring.
